title: evidence-supersession.v1
description: Evidence supersession from a named evidence authority or review bridge through the evidence port. Only the review bridge supersedes a review-failure receipt, when its source report or assessment ceases to be current. Missing authority, provenance, or matching subject rejects the record. Core policy owners approve authority rules; additive reasons remain optional; unknown major versions block supersession.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Core policy owners approve authority rules; unknown major versions block supersession.

supersession_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this supersession record.

superseded_receipt_ids.description: Ordered list of evidence-receipt.v1 identifiers this supersession withdraws.

authority.description: Named authority permitted to issue this supersession.

identity.description: Authority identity (no real names, emails, or personal identifiers in repository artifacts).

provenance.description: Provenance explaining why these receipts are superseded.

reason_code.description: Stable reason code for the supersession.

source_ref.description: Optional reference to the source report or assessment that ceased to be current.
